title: Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies
subtitle: A pilot above Usea
summary: Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies is Namco's PlayStation 2 combat flight game, first released in Japan on 13 September 2001. The player flies as Mobius 1 in a coalition fighting to liberate the continent of Usea from Erusea. body: Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies is Namco's PlayStation 2 combat flight game, first released in Japan on 13 September 2001. The player flies as Mobius 1 in a coalition fighting to liberate the continent of Usea from Erusea. This fictional world combines recognisable military aircraft with enormous weapons and a history shaped by falling asteroids. Eighteen campaign missions move between air battles, ground attacks and major installations. In Europe the game appeared as Ace Combat: Distant Thunder, keeping the same campaign under a different subtitle.

Before a sortie, the player selects an aircraft and its special weapon. A mission focused on ground targets asks for different strengths from a battle against enemy fighters. During flight, a radar and target indicators help locate threats while missiles require a suitable approach and lock. The aircraft carry far more weapons than their real counterparts, allowing the action to continue across long engagements. The result balances the recognisable shape and handling of military aviation with missions built around dramatic attacks and rapid changes of target.

Between missions, illustrated story sequences follow a boy living under occupation and his encounters with the enemy pilot Yellow 13. That viewpoint gives the aircraft fought in the sky a connection to life on the ground. Music changes the scale of key encounters, culminating in a choral finale. The AC04 Project team rebuilt the series' approach after Ace Combat 3, earning strong reviews for the controls, presentation and story. Its fictional setting became an important foundation for later entries in the Ace Combat series.
